title: Warwick-Edinburgh Mental Wellbeing Scale
description: 14 positively worded statements about the past two weeks, each rated 1–5.

citation.text: Tennant R, Hiller L, Fishwick R, Platt S, Joseph S, Weich S, Parkinson J, Secker J, Stewart-Brown S (2007). The Warwick-Edinburgh Mental Well-being Scale (WEMWBS): development and UK validation. Health and Quality of Life Outcomes 5:63.

scoring.text: Sum of the 14 items (14–70); higher is better wellbeing. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
